logical_request.question_set_digest: lowercase SHA256 identifier for the separately resolved question resource
logical_request.serving_configuration_ref: opaque identifier; not an endpoint, account, provider model, token, or permission
logical_request.state: nonempty text; complete authorized evidence assembled by the owning orchestrator

choice.options: finite map of stable option IDs to nonempty text descriptions

score.levels: ordered nonempty text descriptions indexed from zero

capabilities.configuration: trusted overrides only narrow these limits; max_request_bytes plus 512 must not exceed the advertised context count
capabilities.context_qualification: encoded-byte safety bound, not a live tokenizer proof; no silent truncation

normalized_result.usable: status usable, every exact requested answer, reason null
normalized_result.unusable: status unusable, answers null, one fixed safe reason
normalized_result.membership: exact question IDs, types and probability keys; selected choice belongs to the published options; score keys equal all zero-based level indices
normalized_result.numbers: finite; probabilities between zero and one; score between zero and last level
normalized_result.usage: null or exact nonnegative safe-integer input_tokens/output_tokens
normalized_result.serving: reported_model and revision, each a bounded identifier or null; native transport revision is always unknown
normalized_result.unexpected_fields: rejected, including business actions, tools and permissions

rounding.distribution_sum_tolerance: number of options multiplied by half_unit, plus epsilon
rounding.choice_tolerance: selected probability may differ from the maximum by at most two half_units plus epsilon
rounding.weighted_score_tolerance: one plus the sum of zero-based level indices, multiplied by half_unit, plus epsilon
rounding.normalization: retain original finite probability values; do not repair or renormalize malformed distributions

workers_ai.credential_placement: Bearer authorization header inside existing SecretVault CredentialReader

invocation.expected_configuration_digest: approved frozen reader SHA256; must match the reader actually installed in the vault before dispatch

workers_ai.invocation_binding: missing/malformed digest is DECISION_REQUEST_INVALID; a valid but different digest is DECISION_CONFIGURATION_CHANGED; the digest never enters the provider body
workers_ai.native_question_mapping: choice options and score levels become criteria; noul has no criteria in the supported text profile
workers_ai.native_envelope: success plus result; optional empty errors/messages; unexpected fields rejected
workers_ai.native_result: answers plus optional reported model and usage; omitted/null identity or usage is explicitly unknown
workers_ai.score_legend: must exactly match each submitted level description
workers_ai.construction: snapshot approved account/model allowlists, destination, bounds and opaque ref; freeze reader metadata; derive provenance from presence of the fixture transport
workers_ai.configuration_digest: SHA256 of contract/adapter/provider, opaque ref, account/model and sorted allowlists, endpoint/selector, bounds, capabilities, live permission and derived provenance

canonical_orchestration.budget_envelope: reserve with internal max_output_tokens:1; do not send this field to Workers AI; settle null when usage is unknown
canonical_orchestration.required_current_checks: owning orchestrator and vault recheck scope, permissions, task/source/configuration and credential state around asynchronous work

targeted_faults: unpublished option in an otherwise valid response
canonical credential revoked after work preparation and before dispatch
